summary: This paper provides a definitive, formally verified resolution of the multiplicative border rank and exact tensor rank of spin-factor Jordan algebras, matrix Jordan algebras (Sym_n), and classical Lie algebras (so_n, sl_3) using Koszul flattenings, diagonal-slice Strassen commutators, and explicit rational degeneration families. The author proves exact multiplicative separations and establishes universal algebraic ceilings. All 20 core theorems are fully verified in Lean 4 (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) alongside 16 zero-float cryptographic SHA-256 certificates and 56 adversarial pytest checks, achieving exemplary formal rigor and reproducibility.
strengths: Complete resolution of spin-factor Jordan algebra tensor rank (2D-2) and border rank (D+1) with explicit rational degeneration families.
Discovery and universal proof of the Strassen commutator kernel identity [L_A^{-1} L_B, L_A^{-1} L_C](A) = 0 for commutative algebras with invariant symmetric bilinear form.
Pioneering multi-degree Koszul flattening escalation breaking Strassen's wall on Sym_3 (Sym_3 >= 9) and classical Lie algebras (so_5, sl_3).
Flawless formal verification in Lean 4 (20 constructive theorems, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) accompanied by 16 SHA-256 zero-float certificates and exhaustive pytest test suites.
weaknesses: The exposition is dense and algebraically demanding, which may require readers to closely trace the combinatorial tensor indices and explicit degeneration formulas.
Some optimal rank bounds for higher dimensional matrix Jordan algebras and general Lie algebras remain open bounds or require further specialized algebraic constructions.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact border rank RC(J_D) = D + 1 and tensor rank R(J_D) = 2D - 2 for spin-factor Jordan algebras.
Universal commutator kernel identity and skew-symmetry cap for Strassen's commutator equations on symmetric invariant commutative algebras.
Multi-degree Koszul flattening certificates for Sym_3 (breaking Strassen's ceiling 8 to >= 9) and classical Lie algebras so_5 and sl_3.
